title: Finite palette endpoints and degree-square Turán problems
summary: We study finite palette extremal problems motivated by uniform Turán densities of $3$-uniform hypergraphs. Given a self-converse tournament $T$ with at least two vertices, we determine the largest possible number of admissible triples in an $m$-color palette that avoids the left and right palettes associated with $T$.
